desc: Read N and edges, build adjacency list.
Identify leaves (degree 1). Compute total leaf count L.
Iterative DFS from node 1 to compute parent[] and down[] (leaf count in subtree).
For each node v, iterate over neighbors b. If parent[b]==v then leaf_count = down[b] else leaf_count = L - down[v]. Build frequency map of leaf counts among neighbors.
For each node v, find the best y maximizing count[y] * (y+1) (with y >= 1). Add 1 to get the max kept vertices for v. Track global max.
